title: AlertEvent
description: An alert event representing a triggered alert condition on an SAP HANA Cloud service instance. Alerts monitor database health, resources, and operational thresholds.

alertId.description: The unique identifier of the alert event.

alertRuleId.description: The identifier of the alert rule that triggered this event.

alertName.description: The human-readable name of the alert (e.g., Memory Usage, Disk Usage, Long-Running Statements).

alertState.description: The current state of the alert event.

severity.description: The severity level of the alert.

description.description: A detailed description of the alert condition.

triggeredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the alert was triggered.

resolvedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the alert was resolved. Null if the alert is still active.

currentValue.description: The current metric value that triggered or relates to the alert.

thresholdValue.description: The threshold value configured in the alert rule.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the metric values (e.g., %, GB, count).

serviceInstanceId.description: The service instance identifier associated with this alert.
